evaluation.equal_budget_query: Fit one scalar variance multiplier and one central-90% radius per covariance arm and query family from all source episodes only, pooled across physical objects.
evaluation.heldout_query_transfer: For each evaluated query family and covariance arm, fit the same two scalar calibration quantities from the other four query families only, using source episodes only.
evaluation.source_frozen_policy: For each object and arm, select the 40% event-probability quantile on source query-windows and apply that threshold unchanged to target query-windows.
evaluation.target_rank_policy: Descriptive only: within each object and arm, accept exactly the 40% target query-windows with lowest predicted adverse-event probability; stable index resolves ties without reading labels.

questions.equal_calibration_budget: Does full low-rank dependence retain lower Brier score and finite-decision loss when both dependence-destruction controls receive their own equally parameterized source-only calibration?
questions.matched_coverage: At common 40% target-ranked coverage, does full dependence reduce decision loss or harmful accepted events?
questions.source_frozen_threshold: Does the ordering persist when thresholds are chosen from source probabilities only?
questions.query_transfer: Does the dependence advantage survive calibration that excludes the evaluated query family?

claim_boundary: Retrospective robustness evidence on the already-open 92-object Deform360 cohort. It may strengthen or weaken the interpretation that cross-coordinate dependence has decision value under equal calibration budgets and matched coverage. It does not provide fresh confirmation, calibrated field uncertainty, real Prob4D runtime evidence, unseen-object transfer, robot-control safety, or permission to retune the parent predictor or query bank.
